items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: we were engaged to also play at the Roxy Theater

ctx.x: would be in front of the band, we'd play the music and he would be singing and I'd read my music, play with the section and listen to him perform the projection of the melody, the way he'd perform and we'd perform with Velma Middleton, and stayed there, we worked there for a space of about three weeks, after three weeks we were engaged to also play at the Roxy Theater and the following two weeks or was it three weeks, I'm not sure, it was the hardest work I had ever done up to that point. I did some hard work,…

The Roxy Theater was right next to the Taft Hotel on, what is that, 53rd -- I think it's torn down now. But that whole show from the Zanzibar would go, we'd be at the Roxy, including Bill Robinson he was doing his solo, doing his soft shoe with his
